## Summary
The supervisor package monitors local participant publication state and detects stalled publishing transitions. It coordinates per-track publication monitors, periodically checks them for timeout or recovery, and exposes callbacks for publication errors.

## Responsibilities
- Track pending and active publications for a participant.
- Forward participant peer connection, mute, published track, and cleared track events to per-publication monitors.
- Periodically check publication monitors for timeout errors and idle state.
- Report first publication errors through a callback and log later recovery.
- Maintain per-track publication transition queues and timeout detection.

  - Detect publish timeout when a pending start remains unresolved after the wait duration.
  - Consume queued transitions when the published track state satisfies them.
